ui.title: Your Cosmic Personality
ui.intro: The longer the test, the more detailed your result.

items.EI-E-1: After spending time with a big group of friends, I leave with more energy than I had.
items.EI-E-2: I find it easy to talk to new people at a social gathering.
items.EI-E-3: I prefer plans with several people over one-on-one plans.
items.EI-E-4: I think best out loud, talking with others.
items.EI-E-5: I enjoy being the center of attention at a get-together with friends.
items.EI-E-6: When I have a problem, my first instinct is to talk it over with someone right away.
items.EI-E-7: Being surrounded by people almost all the time energizes me.
items.EI-E-8: I meet new people easily at social events.
items.EI-I-1: I prefer going deep with one or two close friends over socializing in a big group.
items.EI-I-2: After a big social event, I need time alone to recharge.
items.EI-I-3: I prefer to listen before speaking in a group conversation.
items.EI-I-4: I think best when I have time alone to process my ideas.
items.EI-I-5: I'd rather spend a quiet night with a close friend than go to a big party.
items.EI-I-6: When I have a problem, I prefer to think it through myself before talking to someone.
items.EI-I-7: I regularly need time alone, even with friends I love.
items.EI-I-8: It takes me a while to feel comfortable with people I've just met.
items.SN-S-1: With my friends I prefer to talk about concrete plans and real experiences.
items.SN-S-2: I prefer practical activities (cooking, sports, a project) over abstract conversations.
items.SN-S-3: I'm more interested in the concrete details of a story than in its overall meaning.
items.SN-S-4: I trust what I can observe directly more than theories or possibilities.
items.SN-S-5: I enjoy conversations about real experiences and specific anecdotes.
items.SN-S-6: I prefer to follow proven methods over experimenting with new approaches.
items.SN-S-7: I like talking about specifics: what happened, when, how.
items.SN-S-8: I appreciate friends who are practical and down to earth.
items.SN-N-1: With my friends I like to explore ideas and possibilities, even abstract ones.
items.SN-N-2: I prefer conversations about the meaning of things over concrete details.
items.SN-N-3: I'm more interested in where something could go than in how it is right now.
items.SN-N-4: I enjoy imagining possibilities and hypothetical scenarios with my friends.
items.SN-N-5: I prefer to try new approaches over doing things the usual way.
items.SN-N-6: I'm drawn to connecting ideas that don't seem related at first glance.
items.SN-N-7: I prefer to talk about theories, patterns or big ideas over day-to-day details.
items.SN-N-8: I appreciate friends who help me see things from a different perspective.
items.TF-T-1: When a friend has a problem, my first instinct is to help them solve it with logic.
items.TF-T-2: I prefer to be honest with a friend even when the truth is uncomfortable.
items.TF-T-3: I make decisions based more on reason than on how they make me feel.
items.TF-T-4: When there's a conflict, I focus on finding the fair solution before everyone's emotions.
items.TF-T-5: I value my friends giving me their honest opinion, even when it's blunt.
items.TF-T-6: I weigh the pros and cons before advising a friend.
items.TF-T-7: I struggle to understand why someone gets upset about something that seems unimportant to me.
items.TF-T-8: I prefer to stay calm and think clearly when a friend is upset.
items.TF-F-1: When a friend has a problem, my first instinct is to validate how they feel.
items.TF-F-2: I prefer to soften my words so I don't hurt a friend, even if it means not being 100% direct.
items.TF-F-3: I make decisions based more on how they affect people than on pure logic.
items.TF-F-4: When there's a conflict, I first focus on how each person feels.
items.TF-F-5: I value my friends being understanding with me, even more than honest.
items.TF-F-6: I put myself in a friend's shoes before giving them any advice.
items.TF-F-7: I easily sense what a friend is going through, even if they don't say it.
items.TF-F-8: When a friend is upset, my priority is to be there for them emotionally.
items.JP-J-1: I like to plan outings in advance.
items.JP-J-2: I prefer to have a clear itinerary when I travel with friends.
items.JP-J-3: I feel uncomfortable when a plan changes at the last minute.
items.JP-J-4: I do what I say I'll do, when I said I'd do it.
items.JP-J-5: I prefer to settle decisions quickly rather than leave them open.
items.JP-J-6: I like get-togethers with friends to have a set time and place well in advance.
items.JP-J-7: I schedule my social activities ahead of time on my calendar.
items.JP-J-8: I prefer to finish one conversation or activity before starting another.
items.JP-P-1: I prefer plans with friends to come up spontaneously.
items.JP-P-2: I prefer to leave room to improvise when I travel with friends.
items.JP-P-3: I enjoy it when a plan changes at the last minute; I find it exciting.
items.JP-P-4: I prefer to keep my options open for as long as possible.
items.JP-P-5: I find it hard to commit to an exact time to meet a friend.
items.JP-P-6: I prefer get-togethers to happen naturally, without much planning.
items.JP-P-7: I decide what to do with friends almost on the spot, not in advance.
items.JP-P-8: I enjoy jumping from one activity to another depending on how I feel in the moment.
